bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; appropriating money for a grant to Forgotten Heroes Ranges and Retreat; requiring reports.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. FORGOTTEN HEROES RANGES AND RETREAT; APPROPRIATION.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $50,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Forgotten Heroes Ranges and Retreat, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, for expenses related to retreats for veterans, including transportation and activities customized for veterans.

Subd. 2.

Report.

By January 15 each year, the commissioner of veterans affairs must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over veterans regarding the uses of the grant in subdivision 1, including any amounts used for administration of the grant. The report must be filed with the Legislative Reference Library in compliance with Minnesota Statutes, section 3.195. As a condition of receiving the grant, Forgotten Heroes Ranges and Retreat must agree to provide the commissioner any information needed to complete the report.
